hypothesis: The Validation-frozen Q92 candidate must improve paired Blind OOS Top-5 hit-share over the same-archive Q89 control by at least 0.005 absolute, with a positive 95% block-bootstrap lower bound and Holm-adjusted block sign-flip p below 0.05.
primary_endpoint: paired Blind OOS Top-5 hit-share difference Q92 minus same-archive Q89
practical_interpretation: 0.5 percentage-point Top-5 hit-share gain, approximately 17 additional number hits over 670 Blind OOS draws (3,350 actual-number observations).
rationale: Prevent acceptance of a statistically significant but practically negligible effect; register the threshold before the Q92 Blind OOS is observed.
limitations: This is a decision gate, not a forecast or claim of expected predictive gain.
The paired Blind OOS is historical and has prior SONAR exposure.
